name: 比尔·英格利希
bio_short: 美国计算机工程师，与道格拉斯·恩格尔巴特共同发明了鼠标。他制造了世界上第一个鼠标原型，并在1968年的“演示之母”中负责了极其复杂的硬件架构和后台技术协调。
bio_short_en: An American computer engineer who co-invented the mouse with Douglas Engelbart. He built the world's first mouse prototype and orchestrated the complex hardware architecture and technical coordination for the 1968 'Mother of All Demos.'
